current.title: Round 55 DELIVERED — the engine-boot round (third packaged-app session)
current.detail: The owner's third desktop session (0.54.0) finally captured the real crash behind every 'Can't reach agent-core': node.exe dying with 'Error: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, lstat 'C:'' on every handshake attempt — Tauri's resource_dir() hands back \?-prefixed VERBATIM paths on Windows and the shell passed them straight to the child (program, script arg, AND cwd); node's module resolver (fs.realpathSync) cannot handle verbatim script paths and dies before the first line of agent-core code. Every path that reaches a child process is now stripped of the verbatim prefix first (simplified_path, pinned by unit tests against the owner's exact log). Second root cause in the same log: 'no provider keys found in Credential Manager' seconds after the launcher stored all four keys — the keyring crate derives Windows target names as {user}.{service} (api-key.ACUTE-CODE/provider/x) while the launcher's cmdkey stores ACUTE-CODE/provider/x: two disjoint namespaces since the first packaged build. keyring is gone, replaced by direct CredReadW/CredWriteW FFI (src/wincred.rs) at the launcher's canonical targets, with the pre-R55 keyring-form targets read as a legacy fallback and retired on the next Settings save. Launcher: prints the changelog 'What's new' panel after an update + explicit next-time guidance (desktop shortcut / ACUTE.bat = update + start). cargo check green on x86_64-pc-windows-gnu incl. --all-targets; launcher logic verified in-sandbox against the real CHANGELOG.
